endpoints.description: Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.summary: Generate a shell command from natural language
endpoints.description: Runs the provider chain (Ollama -> OpenRouter) to produce a single shell command for the given prompt.
Runs the provider chain to produce 1-3 shell-command suggestions for the given prompt.

endpoints.summary: Get AI provider configuration and health
endpoints.description: Returns the persisted provider configs plus runtime health snapshot.
Applies a partial update to one provider's config. Only fields with has_* = true are applied.
Returns only the runtime provider health snapshot.
Returns the full runtime-capability snapshot, including session backends and the active default backend. May trigger expensive verification checks when the server-side cache is stale.
Returns cached full-check results when fresh, otherwise lightweight health checkers only. Suitable for hot-path callers like voice activation.
Returns events and cursor for a session; since_sequence > 0 returns only events after that sequence.
Partial update; only fields with has_* = true are applied.

endpoints.summary: Summarize one assistant event for TTS
endpoints.description: Re-runs the Ollama-backed summarizer on a single event and updates its speech paragraphs.

errors.description: Missing ids or event is not assistant-authored

endpoints.summary: Resolve a file reference for a session
endpoints.description: Translates a path string (with optional :line suffix or file:// scheme) into an absolute path that lives under an allowed root.

endpoints.summary: Read a previewable file referenced by a session
endpoints.description: Returns up to 256 KiB of UTF-8 text content for a path that resolved under an allowed root.

errors.description: File type not previewable or too large

endpoints.description: Server-Sent Events stream for live session/conversation updates consumed by the UI via EventSource.

rest_exception.note: EventSource is a browser primitive with a fixed wire shape. Migration to Connect server-streaming is deferred to the final streams phase.

endpoints.description: Inbound webhook from the Claude Code CLI fired on the Stop lifecycle event. Routes the assistant's final response into the conversation store and (when present) records agent identity for session recovery. Authenticated by the X-Hook-Token header.

rest_exception.note: Called by the Claude Code CLI, which we do not control. Request shape is dictated by Claude Code and cannot be wrapped in a Connect client.

endpoints.description: Inbound webhook from the Claude Code CLI fired when the user submits a prompt. Appends the prompt to the conversation store so the UI sees user turns even when typed through the agent CLI rather than the web console. Authenticated by the X-Hook-Token header.

rest_exception.note: Called by the Claude Code CLI, which we do not control. Request shape is dictated by Claude Code and cannot be wrapped in a Connect client.

endpoints.description: Returns a JSON snapshot of all operational metrics for monitoring/scrape tooling.

rest_exception.note: Metrics are consumed by external monitoring tooling whose scrape format we do not control. Stays REST and never becomes Connect.

endpoints.description: Spawns a PTY (ephemeral) or tmux pane (persistent). X-Idempotency-Key replays the cached response for 5 minutes.
Returns every live session known to the server, including persistent panes adopted from a prior restart.
Returns one session by id.
Idempotent: succeeds whether or not the session existed.
Returns awaiting_recovery rows from the session store, ordered by recency.
Marks a row dismissed without recovery. On-disk state (CODEX_HOME) is preserved.

errors.description: Session is not in awaiting_recovery status

endpoints.description: Spawns a fresh persistent pane, copies CODEX_HOME for codex agents, and pastes the resume command. Idempotent via X-Idempotency-Key.

errors.description: Session is not awaiting_recovery, or no agent identity recorded
Session limit reached while spawning replacement

endpoints.description: Returns the policy plus derived expires_at/ttl_seconds (present only when has_expiry = true).
Sets a new policy. Replaying the same mode+duration is a no-op for the audit event log.

errors.description: Missing id, missing policy, or invalid mode/duration

endpoints.description: Returns the backend and expiration policy applied to newly created sessions when the client doesn't override them.
Sparse update: only the fields the caller sets are applied. Returns the merged defaults.

errors.description: Unknown backend or malformed expiration policy

endpoints.description: Returns the resolved shortcut list — the highest-priority scope (parent > workspace > service) wins, falling back to built-in defaults if no profiles exist.
Returns every stored shortcut profile across all scopes.

endpoints.summary: Create or update a shortcut profile
endpoints.description: Idempotent upsert keyed by id; updated_at is only bumped when content changes.

errors.description: Unknown scope, blank id/name, or shortcut entry missing label/command

endpoints.description: Idempotent: succeeds whether the id exists or not.

endpoints.summary: Upload an image to a terminal session
endpoints.description: Multipart image upload that stores the image under the session workspace so the user can reference it from the terminal by path.

rest_exception.note: Multipart/form-data upload. Stays REST even post-Connect because Connect's wire format does not natively carry multipart payloads.

endpoints.description: Returns the active auto-TTS configuration (backend, voice, speed).
Applies a partial update. Each field has a paired has_* flag indicating intent to set.
Returns the live TTS snapshot: config, hook state, last routing/ack/playback per source, and the Kokoro capability label.
UI clients post playback lifecycle events (start/end/error per source/backend).
Returns the long-response summarization config (threshold, level, model, timeout).
Applies a partial update. has_* flags signal intent to set per field.

errors.description: Invalid level, threshold, timeout, or empty model

endpoints.summary: Synthesize text to audio (returns audio bytes)
endpoints.description: Proxies to the Kokoro backend. event_id + version trigger cache-on-write.

endpoints.summary: Fetch cached TTS audio for an event
endpoints.description: Returns cached audio bytes for (event_id, voice, speed, version). Defaults to version=active.

errors.description: No cached audio for this event

endpoints.description: Returns the list of voice IDs known to the Kokoro backend.
Returns the transcribed text. Honors the server-side speaker-verification gate unless skip_speaker_verification is true.
Returns the voice streaming pipeline tuning (flush, delta, overlap, persistent mode, wake-word knobs).
Applies a partial update. has_* flags signal intent to set per field.
Returns the wake-word configuration. template_json is empty when configured=false.
Validates and persists the WakeWordTemplate JSON payload (samples, label, threshold).

errors.description: Bad sample count, threshold, or kind

endpoints.description: Clears the stored wake-word template.
Returns the speaker-verification gate config.
Applies a partial update. has_* flags signal intent per field.

errors.description: Bad threshold/mode/reject_behavior, or enabled without profiles

endpoints.description: Returns capability state, resource readiness, profile count, and the active config.
Returns the profiles known to the speaker-verification resource.
Enrolls a new profile from audio bytes. Optionally activates it and enables the gate.
Disables the gate and clears active profile IDs.

endpoints.summary: Remove a speaker profile from the active list
endpoints.description: Drops the profile ID from the active list; does not delete from the speaker-verification resource.
Deletes the profile from the speaker-verification resource AND drops it from the active list.
Returns the active pane, ordered panes, and tab groups.
Persists pane ordering and the active pane selection.
Upserts a pane keyed by session_id. Only fields with has_* = true are applied.
Idempotent: succeeds whether the session_id exists or not.
Creates a new tab group with the given name and display color.
Updates fields on an existing tab group. Only fields with has_* = true are applied.
Idempotent. Panes in the group have their group_id cleared.
